name: Resident Economic Empowerment and Sustainability (REES) for NYCHA Residents – NYCHA Development - Local Law 163
description: This dataset reports annual outcomes from the Resident Economic Empowerment and Sustainability (REES) program for residents of New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) developments, published under Local Law 163. Each row covers one NYCHA development in a given year from 2018 through 2024, with roughly 2,400 rows across 361 developments. Fields include the development name, borough, and counts of residents served in various program categories, such as residents enrolled, residents placed in jobs, and other participation measures. Several columns report the average wage of residents in those categories, given as dollar figures. Many counts are suppressed for privacy and appear as "< 5" or "<5" rather than exact numbers, and a substantial share of values are missing, particularly for borough (about 42%) and the wage and count columns (roughly 26% to 90%).
